claims.object_text: Epilepsy in females with mental retardation (EFMR)
claims.quote: EFMR is caused by heterozygous mutations in the PCDH19 gene
The protein is involved in cell adhesion
probably plays an important role in neuronal migration
cell interference as a pathogenic molecular mechanism leading to neuronal dysfunction
encoding protocadherin-19, a protein that is highly expressed during brain development

claims.object_text: heterozygous females affected; hemizygous males not affected
claims.quote: Females with heterozygous mutations are affected, while hemizygous males are not, regardless of mutation carriage.

claims.object_text: PCDH19-related EIEE contributes to ~16% of SCN1A-negative DS-like patients (25% in females)
claims.quote: Recently, PCDH19-related EIEE turned out to be more frequent than initially thought, contributing to around 16% of cases (25% in female groups) in the SCN1A-negative DS-like patients.
